a.lede: Retro techie retrofits Nvidia Windows XP 32-bit drivers with Pascal card support and improved DisplayPort and HDMI support for contemporary displays
a.title: Modder brings Nvidia Pascal GPU support to Windows XP 32-bit

b.lede: Microsoft's Surface Laptop Ultra is now available for pre-order. The company revealed some new Windows 11 features, a new magnetic USB Type-C port, and that the system will work with "hundreds" of video games.
b.title: Microsoft and Nvidia launch Surface Laptop Ultra with RTX Spark
